cut: pipeline cut (owner, 19 Oct: first of the backlog picks) — the papercut pilot of 13 Oct (approved test 11, v2 reviewed 8/10 SHIP) given the news it was always about: Meta's Muse agent coming to its glasses, and Muse's own terms
argument: Meta's glasses are getting an AI agent that buys what you see; Muse's own terms put any loss on you and warn some purchases can't be undone, so looking stops being free.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Meta's glasses are getting / an AI that buys what you see. / Who pays when you [look]?
text.fi: Metan laseihin tulee / tekoäly, joka ostaa näkemäsi. / Kuka maksaa, kun [katsot]?
text.ja: Metaの メガネに / 見た物を 買う AIが 来る。 / 見たら [誰が] 払う？

captions.source: Meta, Introducing Muse (about.fb.com, Sep 2026): the personal AI agent, woken by name ('Hey Muse'), 'coming soon to AI glasses'; it can help you buy products you see (UploadVR; TechCrunch 23 Sep 2026, Connect). Checkout through Stripe Link, a single-use card per purchase, the user approving the total (CNBC 3 Oct 2026). The film's own device is a parody (LOOKSY), and the mask is the device, as in the pilot.

text.en: Its own terms: / the losses are [yours].
text.ja: 利用規約では / 損失は [あなた] 持ち。

captions.source: Muse Supplemental Terms of Service (muse.ai/terms), Financial Actions: the user bears the financial loss from transactions Muse carries out on their instructions (reported by CNBC 3 Oct 2026). A paraphrase, so never in quote marks.

text.ja: 取り消せない 買い物も / [ある]。

captions.source: The same section: certain transactions may be irreversible by their nature (muse.ai/terms; CNBC 3 Oct 2026). Paraphrased.

text.ja: 見るのは 無料*。 / *[規約が] 適用されます。

captions.source: The station's line, paying off the billboard over the queue (LOOKING IS FREE*, *SEE TERMS), over the mask going into a pocket and still glowing there.

wake.why: the wake word, a parody of 'Hey Muse'; the device is the mask, as in the pilot

receipt.en: GLANCE RECEIPT · CAKE ORDERED · BAKERY ACQUIRED · BIRCH LEAF ? · PIGEON FOLLOWED · TOTAL $249 + EVERYTHING
receipt.why: the gag: everything looked at, bought; the total is a joke, not a price claim

post.en: Meta's glasses are getting Muse, an AI agent that can buy what you see. Its own terms say the losses are yours, and some purchases can't be undone. Looking is free*. *Terms apply. #AI #Meta #smartglasses
post.fi: Metan laseihin on tulossa Muse, tekoälyagentti, joka voi ostaa näkemäsi. Sen omien ehtojen mukaan tappiot ovat sinun, eikä kaikkia ostoja voi perua. Katsominen on ilmaista*. *Ehdot pätevät.
post.ja: Metaのメガネに、見た物を買えるAIエージェント「Muse」が来る。利用規約では損失は利用者持ちで、取り消せない買い物もある。見るのは無料*。*規約が適用されます。
